articles.title: The Perseid Meteor Shower Peaks This Week—Here's How to Watch
articles.summary: The Perseid meteor shower peaks August 12-13, with up to 100 meteors per hour. This year's new moon means darker skies. Grab a blanket and look up!

articles.title: Can Singing Cure a Weird Burping Disorder? New Study Says Maybe
articles.summary: A rare disorder causing excessive burping might be helped by singing therapy, a new study suggests. Singing reduced burping more than breathing exercises, but experts question the findings.

articles.title: Swiatek Triumphs in Toronto, Securing First Title of a Challenging Season
articles.summary: Iga Swiatek defeated Elena Rybakina 6-2 6-3 in the Canadian Open final, claiming her first title of the season and 26th career title. It's a comeback after a tough year.
